customDescriptions.value: Analyze and enhance images with edge detection, histogram equalization, contrast adjustment, and blob analysis — use for preprocessing steps that improve feature visibility before detection or recognition
Convert between image formats, color spaces (RGB, HSV, YCbCr), and data types — use to transform image data into the representation required by downstream processing blocks
Access demonstration models for computer vision workflows — use as reference implementations for object detection, tracking, and image processing pipelines
Apply spatial filters (median, Gaussian, bilateral, custom kernels) to images — use for noise reduction, smoothing, or sharpening as part of an image processing pipeline
Apply geometric operations (resize, rotate, warp, crop, affine/projective transforms) to images — use for image registration, perspective correction, or preparing images for fixed-size network inputs
Display Computer Vision Toolbox version and configuration information — use to verify toolbox installation and compatibility
Apply morphological operations (erode, dilate, open, close, top-hat) to binary and grayscale images — use for shape-based filtering, noise removal from binary masks, or object segmentation refinement
Display images and video with annotations in viewer windows — use to visualize intermediate or final results of a vision processing pipeline during simulation
Read images and video from files, cameras, or frame generators — use as input to vision processing pipelines for offline analysis or real-time camera capture
Compute image statistics (mean, variance, histogram, min/max, projection) — use for image quality metrics, automatic thresholding, or feature computation in classification pipelines
Overlay text, shapes, bounding boxes, and markers onto images — use to annotate detection results, draw ROIs, or add labels for visualization and debugging
Apply frequency-domain and spatial transforms (FFT, DCT, Radon, Hough) to images — use for frequency analysis, feature extraction, or line/circle detection in structured scenes
Perform common vision operations like image padding, ROI extraction, frame rate conversion, and matrix reshaping — use as helper blocks connecting major vision processing stages
